name: Purupuru Shirts!
source:
Main character meets a childhood friend after a long time, and their relations begin anew. Natsuki often climbs from the neighboring window to play together. One night she comes while wearing nothing but a shirt. And that incident launched chain reaction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
